source: NCERT Class VII, Curiosity: Textbook of Science, Ch. 12.

sections.heading: 1. The Earth's Movements
points: The Earth shows two motions: **rotation** and **revolution**.
**Rotation** — spinning on its **axis** once in about **24 hours** → causes **day and night**.
**Revolution** — moving around the **Sun** once in about **365¼ days** → with the **tilted axis**, causes the **seasons**.
The Earth's axis is **tilted (about 23.5°)**.

sections.heading: 2. The Moon
points: The **Moon** is Earth's natural **satellite**; it has **no light of its own** and shines by **reflecting sunlight**.
The Moon revolves around the Earth; its changing shapes seen from Earth are the **phases of the Moon** (new moon → full moon → new moon, ~29.5 days).
The Moon has **no atmosphere or water**; footprints remain because there is **no wind**.
The same side of the Moon always faces the Earth.

sections.heading: 3. Eclipses
points: **Solar eclipse** — the **Moon comes between the Sun and the Earth**, casting its shadow on Earth; occurs on a **new moon** day.
**Lunar eclipse** — the **Earth comes between the Sun and the Moon**, casting its shadow on the Moon; occurs on a **full moon** day.
Eclipses happen because light travels in straight lines and objects cast shadows.

sections.heading: 4. The Sun and Beyond
points: The **Sun** is a **star** — the nearest to us — the source of **heat and light** for the Earth.
The **Sun, Earth and Moon** system produces day/night, seasons, tides and eclipses.
Beyond lie other planets, stars and galaxies (our galaxy = the **Milky Way**).

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Rotation (24 h, on axis) → day & night; revolution (365¼ days) + axial tilt → seasons.
Moon = Earth's satellite; shines by reflecting sunlight; phases (~29.5 days).
Solar eclipse = Moon between Sun & Earth (new moon); lunar eclipse = Earth between Sun & Moon (full moon).
Moon has no air/water; same side always faces Earth.
Sun = nearest star; our galaxy = Milky Way.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Day and night = rotation**; **seasons = revolution + axial tilt** — don't swap.
**Solar eclipse** = **Moon** between Sun & Earth (new moon); **lunar eclipse** = **Earth** between Sun & Moon (full moon).
The **Moon has no light of its own** — it reflects sunlight.
The Sun is a **star**, not a planet.
